ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit 3e2d300ad331d7dfd63f399486154edd370a07aa, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are retro-audio:sfx (one short retro sound effect, not a song or loop), songwriting:suno (prompts and tagged lyrics for the Suno AI music service), songwriting:co-write (lyric lines, titles and co-writing sessions), songwriting:rhyme (finding and testing rhymes), speech:narrate (text-to-speech narration with word timings), pixel-art:scene (a self-contained HTML pixel-art scene that can play a WAV it is given) and explainer-video:produce (a narrated Manim explainer video muxed with ffmpeg). music owns writing a short MML score and rendering it as a looping chip-voiced WAV with Game Boy, NES or PICO-8 presets.
